In this episode: What to check before you leave
What to write on the noteboard
How to spend the last ten minutes
Before you start: Photo ID: government-issued, unexpired, exact registration name
Online: stay in webcam view, clear desk
No phone, smart watch or headphones
Arrive or log in early: late past the window forfeits the fee
Accept the confidentiality agreement on screen
The noteboard: Ask if you may write before the clock starts
Strike: faster or bigger · polite instruction · pasted data
Cost first → batch · untrusted → separate + enforce · several apps → MCP server · must never → control · parsed output → validate
Dropdowns: each statement alone · unknown flag → strike it
Item formats: Multiple response: read how many first
No domain labels: read the stem, not a heading
When an item stalls you: Best answer, flag it, move on
Three hard in a row: one breath, then read the last line first
Behind at a checkpoint: past 2 minutes, answer and flag
The last ten minutes: Change an answer only for a reason in the stem
Pass or fail with a scaled score; 720 passes
